items.problem: `_clear_pre_init_values` clears only TimeCore, but DataCore keeps the same kind of pre-init DEV value: `DataCoreDev.set_test_data_location` (client/godot/core/data_core/dev/data_core_dev.gd:7) sets `DataCore._builtin_location`, which only `DataCore.release` resets (client/godot/core/data_core/data_core.gd:73), and `BootstrapCore._release_entry` (client/godot/core/bootstrap_core/bootstrap_core.gd:1343) calls `release` only on initialized modules. A test that calls `set_test_data_location` and ends before `DataCore.init` leaves the location for the next test, against "A test does not depend on the results or the run order of other tests" (skills/client-core/modules/unit-test-core.md:41). This existed before the range; found from the code path, not run. The core agent report lists further modules of this kind (AuthCoreDev, GameUpdateCoreDev, NoticeCoreDev, ResourceCore, AccessibilityCore) that were not checked here
